summary: Frontend-only verification of the two deferred CRM features via the public preview URL. Logged in on the platform login page (owner@isodemo.com) which auto-bridged into /crm, opened Companies tab -> New Company (Commercial kind default confirmed). (1) Global postcode auto-fill: US 90210 -> Beverly Hills / California PASSED in BOTH field orders (postcode-first + country-blur re-lookup, and country-first), DE 10115 -> Berlin / Berlin PASSED, UK SW1A 1AA -> Westminster / London PASSED. (2) Headless website fetch on the bot-protected reh-fit.com: cached URL (https://www.reh-fit.com) returned in ~3s and an UNCACHED variant (https://reh-fit.com/) live-rendered in ~12s; both populated Name 'Reh-Fit', Phone '+12044888023', Email 'reh-fit@reh-fit.com', Website, summary '5 fields filled / 3-4 pages read / 4 social links' and NO 'blocked' note. Core feature verdict: both features work end-to-end in the UI. Found 1 notable UI overlay defect (cookie banner covers the Create button) plus 2 minor issues.

ui_bugs.issue: The fixed cookie-consent banner overlays the bottom of the modal: document.elementFromPoint at the centre of the Create button returns the cookie banner div (DIV.max-w-4xl mx-auto bg-zinc-900...), not the button (sameOrInside=false). At 1920x1080 a user who has not dismissed cookies cannot click Create company. Postcode/other inputs are not obstructed.

UK lookup overwrites the user-typed Country. Entering 'United Kingdom' + SW1A 1AA leaves Country = 'England' (postcodes.io country). City/County only fill when empty (prev.city || ...) but country is set unconditionally (r.data.country || prev.country) — inconsistent and degrades data quality for UK records.

integration_issues.issue: Panel copy promises 'name, phone, email, address, description & social links' but address_line1 / city / postcode / county stay empty for reh-fit.com (backend returns no address). Expected per backend behaviour, but the promise vs. result mismatch is misleading — consider only claiming address when returned.
Console/network noise: GET /api/master-admin/companies-house/status returns 403 (twice) for owner@isodemo.com. Should be gated client-side on master-admin.

issues: Cookie banner + 'Install App' PWA prompt both stack over the modal footer, hiding the primary action
Dialog is long; the primary Create action sits below the fold with no sticky footer

action_items: Raise the New Company dialog z-index above the cookie-consent banner (or add a sticky modal footer / suppress the banner + PWA install prompt while a modal is open) so [data-testid=company-create-submit] is clickable.
Make the postcode lookup respect a user-entered Country (only fill when empty, or map postcodes.io 'England/Scotland/Wales' back to 'United Kingdom').
Hide/skip the master-admin companies-house status call for non-master-admin CRM users (currently 403 x2).
critical_code_review_comments: CRMCompanies.js onBlur lookup: city/county use `prev.city || r.data.city` but country uses `r.data.country || prev.country` — asymmetric, causes the UK 'England' overwrite.
CRMCompanies.js is 2547 lines — well over the 700-line guideline; split the create dialog / MOD sites panel into separate components.
CRMCompanies.js autoRecognize/autoRecognizeFromWebsite swallow errors silently ('/* silent */') for the AI-fill path — no user-visible error state.

success_rate.frontend: 100% of the 4 requested feature cases passed; 4 side issues found

seed_data_creation: None persisted — no company was submitted (typed 'TEST_Overlay Check' into the name field only, dialog abandoned).
test_credentials: Platform login owner@isodemo.com / IsoDemo123! at /login?next=/crm auto-bridges into the CRM (direct /crm hit redirects to /login, the CRM-only login form at data-testid=crm-login-page was never shown).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Navigate to /login?next=%2Fcrm and use gx-login-* testids; /crm alone redirects to the platform login. CRM lands on Dashboard — click [data-pill-id="companies"] to reach the Companies list (create-company-btn). Company name input testid is 'company-name-autocomplete-input' (NOT company-field-name). Website fetch results are cached 24h per exact URL — vary the URL (e.g. drop 'www.') to exercise the live headless render (~12s). Dismiss the cookie banner/'Later' PWA prompt before clicking modal footer buttons.
rca_of_the_issue: Cookie-consent banner is rendered as a fixed bottom element outside the modal stacking context with an equal/higher z-index, so it hit-tests above the dialog footer. The UK country overwrite comes from postcodes.io returning country='England', which the frontend applies unconditionally.
